item.title: OCaml Weekly News, 11 Aug 2026
item.description:
1. Dune 3.24
  2. New releases of Merlin and OCaml-LSP for OCaml 5.5 and trunk
  3. sdl3 bindings
  4. JFLA2027 : Premier appel à communications
  5. hegel 0.14.0
  6. New release 1.1.0 of ifs-fractals
  7. OSEC-2026-14: mirage-crypto-pk: RSA signature verification raises undocumented exception
  8. OSEC-2026-15: mirage-crypto-ec: EC public key out of bounds read
  9. New package: floatml
  10. ocaml-android reboot!
  11. Ravel 1.0.1 — a functional language compiling to interaction nets
  12. New package: P4-SpecTec
  13. New package: NeoDriver 0.1.2 – Neo4j Database driver
  14. opam-audit
  15. shakuhachi v0.3.2 - A music collection manager
  16. Bytream 0.1 – first release
  17. Smaji Glyph Path
  18. Smaji Glyph Path, two usage examples, Smaji Outline Description and Smaji Stroke Description
